name: Dragon Will

acquire.equipPiece: One lavender aether-rune gauntlet on the casting forearm (gold runes glow when Static Void fires); body stays human.

integrate.transformation: Full armoured form Realmheart dragon-humanoid: white-orange-tipped mane over swept horns, glowing lavender eyes with gold under-eye runes, gold runes down both arms, ornate white-lavender dragon plate on shoulders and spine, digitigrade clawed greaved legs, a long spined tail, two membrane wings and an aether-fang blade grown from the forearm.

equip.weapon: A long aether-glass dragon-fang blade grown from the right forearm, gold runes down the flat.
equip.armor: Ornate white-and-lavender dragon plate: scaled pauldrons, spine ridge plates, runed bracers and greaves, a folded two-wing membrane cape.
equip.hair_eyes: Hair turns white with orange tips and sweeps back over two horns; eyes glow lavender, gold runes under the eyes.
equip.aura: Lavender-gold aether aura with drifting rune motes and a faint space-warp shimmer.

beastNote: Mana Dragon (Sylvia, who gave her will to Arthur)
lore: The Dragon's Will, an Asuran dragon's will of the Indrath line (Aether) that Sylvia gave to Arthur. A holder first borrows its grip on aether (Static Void); only a trained one becomes the Realmheart dragon-humanoid.
pitch: Sylvia's Dragon Will is the will of an Asuran dragon of the Indrath line, handed to Arthur. Acquire keeps you human with lavender afterimages and one equipped piece, a single aether-rune gauntlet, so you can step through aether and briefly freeze time (Static Void). Integrate (Realmheart) makes you a white-maned dragon-humanoid in gold-runed aether plate that sees mana and bends space; it burns the highest drain in the roster and is painful until mastered.
untrained: Canon: Arthur felt pain from Sylvia's will. DESIGN: the highest strain of any will (acquire 0.28/s, integrate 1.4/s); an untrained holder's screen shudders, aether backlash burns mana and hearts whenever Static Void or the breath is cast past the trained level. CANON ADDENDUM 2: the will lies dormant in the holder's mana core until it is forcefully awakened (a flame sparked in the core); if the holder cannot suppress and balance it, the clashing energies wreck body and core and can kill (design: strain climbs fast, backlash damage, forced cancel at the cap); mastery means training both the holder's own core and the beast core, best taught by the beast itself. This will summons no beasts or hordes.

spirit.echo: A tall dragon-humanoid in white and lavender aether plate: swept-back horned head, white mane, slit lavender-gold eyes, scaled digitigrade legs, thick spined tail, two membrane wings, clawed hands, aether-fang blade.
spirit.look: A faceted lavender-aether orb with a slit gold pupil, two slow-turning gold rune rings and a faint folded-wing glimmer inside.
